_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. GlossGenius's three public surfaces declare separate vocabularies (raw/css-vars.json): core.* carries the marketing site's Webflow variable layer and flat palette (including the declared but never-painted [data-theme=dark] declarations), app.* carries the glossDS layer the signed-out auth forms paint, booking.* the published booking site's own token family. Measured roles alias to the declared values they match, inside their own surface set.

display.description: The display family the surfaces set on headings (baselGrotesk/baselClassic over Helvetica fallbacks).
